name: check-machines
description: Check connectivity of a specific machine in your ollama fleet - WS-RAREBOX, V9-MINI, or WS-VISION

commands.prompt: curl -s --max-time 5 http://{{host}}:11434/api/version | jq . || echo 'Failed to connect'

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Hostname (prefer plain machine name, with no .lan or .local suffix)
